nulltrace.config.title: NullTrace Settings
nulltrace.section.restartWarning: §e⚠ Requires game restart to take effect
nulltrace.option.spoofAsVanilla.tooltip:
On: advertise a vanilla brand and block ALL mod(s) from detection
Off: advertise as real Fabric brand and optionally allow some mod(s)
nulltrace.option.whitelistMode.locked.to: Locked to 'Block All' because Spoof as Vanilla is on
nulltrace.whitelist.mode.auto.tooltip: Mods with network channels are automatically whitelisted
nulltrace.whitelist.mode.custom.tooltip: Manually select which mods to whitelist
nulltrace.packstrip.mode.manual.tooltip: Default vanilla behavior on push. You can still toggle any server pack
nulltrace.packstrip.mode.ask.tooltip: Server resource pack not applied but with consent screen to ask if the pack(s) should be applied
nulltrace.packstrip.mode.alwaysOn.toolti: Server resource pack not applied by default. You can still toggle any server pack
nulltrace.packstrip.title: Server Resource Pack
nulltrace.packstrip.required: This server has a required resource pack.
nulltrace.packstrip.optional: This server has an optional resource pack.
nulltrace.packstrip.stripped: §7NullTrace bypassed this pack's content. You may apply it below.
nulltrace.account.addSession.tooltip: Add a new account using a session token
nulltrace.update.title: NullTrace Update Available
nulltrace.update.message: A new version of NullTrace is available!
nulltrace.tamper.title: NullTrace Integrity Check
nulltrace.tamper.warning: §e§lThis jar is not the official release build
nulltrace.tamper.mismatch: §7NullTrace compared this file with the SHA-256 published for the matching release.
nulltrace.tamper.malicious: §7That is normal for a repacked download, a branch build, or a local build.
nulltrace.tamper.compromised: §7Treat it as tampering only if you did not install this build yourself.
nulltrace.tamper.action: §7Official builds are on CurseForge and GitLab Releases (see the README).
nulltrace.alert.shaderStrip.multi: Stripped server-pack shader overrides targeting %d mods: %s
nulltrace.hint.alertsCanBeDisabled: Chat and toast alerts can be disabled in NullTrace > Misc settings.
nulltrace.command.help.info: /nulltrace info [mod]  - Show tracked mods or details for a specific mod
nulltrace.command.help.channels: /nulltrace channels    - Show all tracked network channels
nulltrace.command.overview.noMods: No mods with trackable content found.
nulltrace.command.info.useList: Use /nulltrace info to see available mods
nulltrace.whitelist.tooltip.requiredBy: %s — required by %s (uncheck the depender to release)
nulltrace.command.info.statusBlockedAuto: Whitelist Status: BLOCKED (AUTO mode - no channels)
nulltrace.command.channels.none: No channels tracked yet. Try /nulltrace scan
nulltrace.account.screen.session.title: Add Account
nulltrace.button.reset.disabled.tooltip: Reset is disabled on Accounts tab
nulltrace.option.isolatePackCache.toolti: Store packs per-account to prevent fingerprinting
nulltrace.option.blockLocalPackUrls.tool: Block local URL resource pack requests
nulltrace.option.stripModShaders.tooltip: Strip server resource pack shader overrides targeting non-whitelisted mods
nulltrace.option.clearCache.tooltip:
Deletes all cached server resource packs
Also resets download queue state
nulltrace.option.keyResolutionSpoofing.t: Mask translation key values to appear as default vanilla client
nulltrace.option.fakeDefaultKeybinds.too: Spoof vanilla keybinds to default values when enabled
nulltrace.option.meteorFix.tooltip: Blacklist a Meteor Client mixin to allow NullTrace's proper protection handling
nulltrace.option.disableTelemetry.toolti: Block telemetry data sent to Mojang
nulltrace.option.blockServerCookies.tool: Do not store or answer cookies sent by servers; may break proxy networks that depend on cookies.
nulltrace.option.blockServerTransfers.to: Prevent a server from silently transferring this client to another host.
nulltrace.option.showAlerts.tooltip: Show chat messages when tracking detected
nulltrace.option.logDetections.tooltip: Log detection events to game log
nulltrace.option.debugAlerts.tooltip: Show alerts for all probed keys, even unchanged ones
nulltrace.option.debugCommand.tooltip: Enables detailed /nulltrace registry commands (info, channels). Audit and profile are always available.
nulltrace.button.refresh.tooltip:
Revalidate all accounts
Invalid tokens will be marked red
nulltrace.option.serverProfile.tooltip: Profile for the current server. Profiles can strengthen global protections without changing your default settings.
nulltrace.command.help.audit: /nulltrace audit - Show the current connection privacy audit
nulltrace.warning.title: NullTrace privacy check
nulltrace.warning.headline.exposed: §e§lThis server can identify parts of your client
nulltrace.warning.headline.notice: §e§lA few details will be shared with this server
nulltrace.warning.headline.ok: §a§lNothing about your client is being shared
nulltrace.warning.reassurance: §7Nothing has been sent yet. NullTrace can block these before you join.
nulltrace.warning.reassurance.ok: §7NullTrace blocks the surfaces this server can probe.
nulltrace.warning.button.back.tooltip: Return to the server list without connecting
nulltrace.warning.button.protect.tooltip: Use the strict profile for this server, then join
nulltrace.warning.button.details.tooltip: Show the exact counters and where to review them
nulltrace.warning.button.mute.tooltip: Keep or drop this screen for this server. Decisions are still logged either way.
nulltrace.warning.button.settings.toolti: Open NullTrace settings for this server
nulltrace.option.proxyMode.tooltip:
Direct: ignore any launcher proxy.
Launcher: use the proxy Minecraft was started with.
Selected: use one of your saved endpoints (Advanced → Manage proxies).
nulltrace.option.proxyManage.tooltip: Paste, select, reorder and test saved proxy endpoints
nulltrace.proxy.note.line1: §7Applies to HTTP traffic: accounts, skins, resource packs, telemetry, updates.
nulltrace.proxy.note.line2: §7The game-server connection is not affected by a client proxy.
nulltrace.proxy.screen.title: Proxy endpoints
nulltrace.proxy.screen.hint: §7Paste an endpoint, then Add. Selected endpoint is used when mode is Selected.
nulltrace.proxy.screen.add.tooltip: Save this endpoint and select it
nulltrace.proxy.screen.test.tooltip: Check that the selected endpoint answers a proxy request
nulltrace.proxy.error.credentials: §cCredentials aren't supported — Java can't send proxy passwords here. Use an endpoint that needs no login.
nulltrace.proxy.error.path: §cOnly a host and port — remove the path or query
nulltrace.option.checkUpdates.tooltip:
Ask CurseForge and GitLab whether a newer release exists, once per game start.
Uses the proxy above. Off means no version request leaves this computer.
nulltrace.option.verifyJar.tooltip:
Compare this jar against the SHA-256 published with the matching release, once per game start.
Skipped automatically for branch and local builds. Off means no checksum request is made.
